page_title: REN 0-1 AUX | Rennes v Auxerre 06/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+4' 18:11 – the total goal attempt statistics.
90+2' The substitution is prepared. Rudy Matondo (Auxerre) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Assane Diousse.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

89' 0 - 1 Goal! The ball is swung into the box from the resulting corner kick and finds Jubal Junior (Auxerre), who jumps highest and tries his luck with a header from around the penalty spot. His effort is both strong and precise enough to go into the bottom right corner. The score changes to 0:1.
89' Corner kick. Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) is ready to send the ball into the box.
88' Auxerre are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence. The referee points to the corner flag and Auxerre will take a corner.
87' Ismael Kone (Rennes) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
86' Habib Beye prepares a substitution. Mohamed Meite is replaced by Mahamadou Nagida (Rennes).
86' Substitution. Djaoui Cisse leaves the pitch and is replaced by Jordan James (Rennes).
83' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 5:2.
80' Habib Beye has decided to substitute Hans Hateboer and he is replaced by Mousa Tamari (Rennes).
78' Florian Aye (Auxerre) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
77' The resulting set piece from Auxerre is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
77' Auxerre are passing the ball across the pitch and keep possession. However, an opponent intercepts a pass and the situation changes. The referee signals a corner kick to Auxerre.
76' Anthony Rouault (Rennes) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Florent Batta saw the whole situation.
73' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
72' Substitution. Fredrik Oppegard (Auxerre) has come on for Gideon Mensah.
72' Here comes a substitution. Paul Joly (Auxerre) is brought on as a substitute for Ki-Jana Hoever.
72' Substitution. Florian Aye (Auxerre) in, Ado Onaiwu out.
71' Habib Beye has decided to make a change. Azor Matusiwa (Rennes) replaces Seko Fofana.
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ismael Kone (Rennes) is coming onto the pitch as Kazeem Olaigbe cannot continue after picking up an injury.
70' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) plants a strong header from outside the box against the crossbar.
70' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rennes.
69' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Rennes.
68' Anthony Rouault (Rennes) wins himself enough space to meet the resulting corner on the edge of the box and fires the ball at goal, but the keeper does well to stop his effort.
68' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) is about to take a corner kick.
67' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Rennes are awarded a corner kick.
66' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Rennes comes to nothing.
66' Rennes move the ball around well as they wait for an opportunity to shoot, but the attack is halted as they lose possession. Rennes will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
61' Seko Fofana (Rennes) climbs high to connect with a cross on the edge of the box, but his header is off-target.
59' Ki-Jana Hoever (Auxerre) commits a rough challenge and Florent Batta blows his whistle for an infringement.
58' Djaoui Cisse (Rennes) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Florent Batta blows for a foul.
56' Anthony Rouault (Rennes) jumps for a header from the resulting corner kick inside the box and sends the ball in on goal, but the goalkeeper makes a very good save.
56' The referee awards a corner and Adrien Truffert (Rennes) goes over to take it.
56' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Rennes have been awarded a corner kick.
55' Rennes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

54' Donovan Leon pulls off a great save to deny Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far! Rennes win a corner.
53' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
51' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
50' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) latches on to a cross to head the ball wide of the net. A poor header.
48' Anthony Rouault (Rennes) makes a strong challenge and Florent Batta blows for a foul.
46' Han-Noah Massengo (Auxerre) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' Mohamed Meite (Rennes) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the right post.
44' A dangerous looking corner kick from Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) is cleared to safety by the defence.
43' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The linesman makes the right call and Auxerre will have a corner.
43' Mohamed Meite (Rennes) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
41' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) decides to have a go at goal from the long-range free kick, but the wall jumps as one and makes the block. Danger averted!
40' Jubal Junior (Auxerre) was too forceful with his tackle and Florent Batta interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Rennes win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.

39' Sinaly Diomande (Auxerre) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
38' Rennes have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

38' Good work from Rennes as they win a corner. Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Donovan Leon.
37' Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Auxerre.
36' Florent Batta blows his whistle after Anthony Rouault (Rennes) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
36' Rennes enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
34' The ball possession is 66:34.
32' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Auxerre was in an offside position.
32' The corner is swung in but Auxerre can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
31' Jubal Junior (Auxerre) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked. Auxerre have been awarded a corner kick.
31' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

30' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) dribbles into space and finds himself in a shooting position, but his shot from the edge of the box is bravely blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Auxerre are awarded a corner kick.
29' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
27' Flag up against Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
26' Hans Hateboer (Rennes) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Florent Batta blows his whistle for a foul.
24' The foul by Mohamed Meite (Rennes) was seen by Florent Batta who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
22' Djaoui Cisse (Rennes) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Donovan Leon has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
21' Seko Fofana (Rennes) wins himself enough space to meet the resulting corner on the edge of the box and fires the ball at goal, but the keeper does well to stop his effort.
21' Kazeem Olaigbe (Rennes) will deliver the corner kick.
20' Djaoui Cisse (Rennes) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Now Rennes have a corner.
19' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. Auxerre will take a throw-in.
17' Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
16' Rennes are ruled offside.
14' Florent Batta blows his whistle. Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) commits a foul after dangerous play.
13' Djaoui Cisse (Rennes) decides to take on a mid-range shot after a rebound falls into his path, but he was unbalanced and the shot subsequently goes well wide of the left post.
13' A long ball forward to Mohamed Meite (Rennes) is intercepted.
11' The Rennes players are exchanging some short passes.
10' Ki-Jana Hoever (Auxerre) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
9' Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Florent Batta blows for a foul.
6' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Auxerre.
5' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Assane Diousse (Auxerre) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Brice Samba easily catches the ball.
3' Seko Fofana (Rennes) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the right-hand post.
2' Rennes take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
2' Rennes are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block. Rennes get a corner.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Florent Batta is introduced as the referee for today's match.
The players are out at last! Rennes will take the kick-off.
